samples.title: Ribbon runs: Proof strip
samples.statement:
Inputs
`line` is text. A character is one letter, digit, space, or punctuation mark.

Your tasks
1. Create a list `runLengths`. A run is a group of matching characters next to each other. End a run only when the character changes or the text ends. Record the length of each run, from left to right. Spaces count as characters too. For "aa bb", `runLengths` is [2, 1, 2].
2. Complete `ribbonRunsProofStrip` so it returns `runLengths`. Return it, do not print it.

Example
If `line` is "zs  yac", then `runLengths` is [1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1] and `ribbonRunsProofStrip` returns [1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1].

Rules
- If `runLengths` is empty, return [].

Test data
TEST DATA 1: `line` is "hxxtf hfffl".
TEST DATA 2: `line` is "XX xXX".

samples.title: Ribbon runs: Floor ticket
samples.statement:
Inputs
`line` is text. A character is one letter, digit, space, or punctuation mark.

Your tasks
1. Create a list `runLengths`. A run is a group of matching characters next to each other. End a run only when the character changes or the text ends. Record the length of each run, from left to right. Spaces count as characters too. For "aa bb", `runLengths` is [2, 1, 2].
2. Find the smallest number in `runLengths`. Store it in `smallest`.
3. Complete `ribbonRunsFloorTicket` so it returns `smallest`. Return it, do not print it.

Example
If `line` is "ck  zji", then `runLengths` is [1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1] and `ribbonRunsFloorTicket` returns 1.

Rules
- If `runLengths` is empty, return 0.

Test data
TEST DATA 1: `line` is "cyylr oxxxl".
TEST DATA 2: `line` is "YY yYY".

samples.title: Ribbon runs: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
Inputs
`line` is text. A character is one letter, digit, space, or punctuation mark.

Your tasks
1. Create a list `runLengths`. A run is a group of matching characters next to each other. End a run only when the character changes or the text ends. Record the length of each run, from left to right. Spaces count as characters too. For "aa bb", `runLengths` is [2, 1, 2].
2. Multiply each number in `runLengths` by its position, counting from 1: the first number by 1, the second by 2, and so on.
3. Add those products. Store the sum in `weightedTotal`.
4. Complete `ribbonRunsBossReceipt` so it returns `weightedTotal`. Return it, do not print it.

Example
If `line` is "jp  pvb", then `runLengths` is [1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1] and `ribbonRunsBossReceipt` returns 24.

Rules
- If `runLengths` is empty, return 0.

Test data
TEST DATA 1: `line` is "kuuow bnnnq".
TEST DATA 2: `line` is "UU uUU".
